# testdata/real

Real-world recordings stay **out of the repository** (licensing, size, and
privacy). This directory exists so the three §33 categories are explicit:

| Directory        | Contents                                     | Committed? |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| `unit/`          | tiny hand-written deterministic GPX fixtures | yes        |
| `synthetic/`     | generated by `examples/generate_corpus.rs`   | yes        |
| `real/`          | your own recorded/downloaded GPX files       | no         |

## Adding your own recordings

Drop `.gpx` files here. Any test that wants them should skip cleanly when the
directory is empty. Nothing in the engine or the gate commands depends on
real data, so a missing `real/` never breaks a build.

The `.gpx` files in this directory are ignored by git; see `.gitignore`.
